verses.1: These are the descendants of Israel who left the land of Egypt to go back to their homes, under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
verses.2: And Moses wrote down their journeys according to God’s will. These are the journeys they would take in order to find their way.
verses.3: They set out from Ramesses in the first month, after fifteen days of the first month. After Passover began, the children of Israel set out with high spirits, in front of all the Egyptians.
verses.4: And the Egyptians shall carry away what Yahweh has struck them with. All their gods and idols will be destroyed by Yahweh.
verses.5: And the sons of Israel journeyed from Rehmeses, and they camped at Sukkot.
verses.6: And they traveled from the wilderness, and they stopped at those places that were located at the edge of the desert.
verses.7: And they departed from them. They sat down under the trees that were in front of Baal-Zefon’s house. They camped there before the hill.
verses.8: They traveled past the Hiron Desert, then crossed the coastal sea. They spent three days in the desert before they finally reached a place where they could rest.
verses.9: They traveled from Mara, and they arrived at Eilam. There were twelve eyes of water in Eilam. They also had seventy Tamarim. They stopped there.
verses.10: And they traveled from Eilam, and they stopped at the Sea of Sef.
verses.11: And they traveled from the Sea of Galilee, and they stopped in the Sea of Sin.
verses.12: And they traveled from the land of China, and they stopped in Dafka.
verses.13: And they traveled from Dapkha, and they stopped in Alush.
verses.14: And they traveled from Alush, and they stopped in Refidim. There was no water available for the people to drink.
verses.15: And they set out from their camp and stopped by the coast of China.
verses.16: And they traveled from the Mediterranean Sea, and they stopped at the camps of the Taw’ah.
verses.17: And they traveled from the tombs of the dead, and they stopped at the courtyards.
verses.18: And they left the courtyards and stopped at Rithma.
verses.19: And they traveled from Rithma, and they stopped in Rimon Paretz.
verses.20: And they traveled from Rimón Paretz, and they stopped in Libna.
verses.21: And they traveled from Libna, and they stopped in Rissa.
verses.22: And they traveled from Rezah, and they stopped in Khehalatah.
verses.23: And they departed from their camp and stopped at Mount Shafar.
verses.24: And they traveled from Har Shafar, and they stopped in Harada.
verses.25: And they traveled from Haradah, and they stopped in Makheloth.
verses.26: And they traveled from the gatherings, and they stopped at a place under the trees.
verses.27: And they traveled downward, and they stopped at Tarah.
verses.28: And they traveled from Tarah and stopped at Mitkah.
verses.29: And they traveled from Metkha, and they stopped in Hasmonah.
verses.30: And they traveled from Chashmona, and they stopped at Moserot.
verses.31: And they traveled from Moserot, and they stopped in the towns of Yaakov.
verses.32: And they traveled from the towns of Yaakov, and they stopped at Hor HaGidgad.
verses.33: And they traveled from the land of Gadad, and they stopped at Yatvatah.
verses.34: And they traveled from Yatvatah, and they stopped at Abrona.
verses.35: And they traveled from Avronah, and they stopped at Etzion Gaver.
verses.36: And they traveled from Etzion Gaver, and they stopped in the desert of Zin, which is holy.
verses.37: And they traveled from the holy place, and they stopped at the mountain in the corner of the land of Edom.
verses.38: And Aaron, the priest, went up to the mountain, according to God’s command. There he died in the forty-second year after the Israelites left Egypt. It was on the fifth month, on the first day of the sixth month.
verses.39: And Aaron, the son of Shelah, was twenty-one years old when he died on Mount Hor.
verses.40: And the Canaanite king of Ardam heard this. He ruled over the land of Canaan, while the children of Israel were leaving that land.
verses.41: And they departed from Mount Horeb, and they stopped in Zalmonah.
verses.42: And they traveled from Tsalmonah, and they stopped in Poonon.
verses.43: And they traveled from Punan, and they stopped in Obot.
verses.44: And they traveled from Opho, and they stopped at the borders of Moab.
verses.45: And they traveled from Eyiim, and they stopped in Dibon Gad.
verses.46: And they traveled from Dibon Gad, and they stopped in Elmon Diblataymah.
verses.47: And they traveled from Almón Diblatayma, and they stopped in the mountains of Haborim, before Nevo.
verses.48: And they traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and they camped at Moab on the banks of the Jordan River.
verses.49: They camped on the Jordan River, from the house of Shechem to the ruins of Gibeah.
verses.50: And the LORD spoke to Moses at twilight on the mountain of Mount Sinai.
verses.51: I speak to the children of Israel, and I say to them: You are going across the Jordan to the land of Canaan.
verses.52: And you shall take possession of all the inhabitants of the land from among yourselves. You shall destroy all their livestock and all their animals. You shall also destroy all their dwellings.
verses.53: And you shall inherit the land, and you shall dwell in it, for I have given you this land to inherit.
verses.54: And you shall settle in this land, according to your families. In this way, your land will become fertile, but it will also become less fertile for those who come after them. Those who settle here will become like the descendants of your ancestors.
verses.55: And if you do not drive out those who live on the earth from before you, then they will continue to live among you, and they will be your enemies. They will cause you trouble in the land where you live.
verses.56: And just as I did for them, I will do the same for you.
